name: Generic jet UCAV with 2 × AIM-120 (AIM-120C-DCS), illustrative
description: GENERIC-UCAV carrying the DCS-fitted AIM-120C-DCS, the missile of F-16C-DCSFIT, so a 2 UCAV v 1 manned fight uses one missile model on both sides; with a short launch delay for an operator's consent over the datalink (the UCAV has no cockpit work). Illustrative values, not data for any real aircraft.
